name: Sale To POI Reconciliation Request V 08
definition: The SaleToPOIReconciliationRequest message is sent by a sale system to request for reconciliation between sale and POI systems.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics related to the transfer of the request.

ReconciliationRequest.name: Reconciliation Request
ReconciliationRequest.definition: Information related to the reconciliation request.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
